summary: The PR addresses a functional incompleteness in the formfield_for_manytomany() function by allowing widget overriding, but it could be improved with additional tests and documentation.

issues.description: The change only addresses the specific case where widget is a function, but it does not cover other possible edge cases.
There are no additional tests added to cover the new functionality.
The code style and formatting are consistent with the rest of the file, but it would be good to add a docstring to explain the purpose of the change.
